Virginia Residential Valuation Screener

An interactive spatial machine learning tool built on 23,435 deduplicated Virginia single-family listings using a LightGBM Regressor (R² = 0.8502).

  • Charcoal Hubs: ZIP-code submarket benchmarks sized by active listing volume.
  • Green Pins: Listings priced ≥ 20% below modeled fair value.
  • Red Pins: Toggleable layer for listings priced ≥ 25% above modeled value.
  • Spatial Note: Pins use ZIP-centroid dispersion (~0.8 mi) to prevent overlap.
